The Elbow Pain Study

A free 3-session study for SF adults with lingering elbow pain. We track your pain score before and after each session.

Study details

Why it works

Elbow pain like this is caused by one part of the forearm and elbow working too hard while another part isn’t working enough. The protocol rebalances the two, which relieves the pain.

Who’s running it

Amari Method, a somatic movement practice in San Francisco.

What to expect

Three 15-minute sessions at our office, 662 8th Ave. There is no charge. After the first session, you can choose whether to complete the study.

What happens with the results

When the study closes at 30 participants, we’ll publish the full findings, the before-and-after pain scores across the whole cohort. Participants are identified by first name only, and only with their consent.

The study protocol is public and dated before recruitment. Read the protocol.
